temperature.source: worn behind the ear: skin at 33 C to 37 C in a room or outdoors; the charger MCP73831 and the cell are not charged under 0 C or over 45 C

tolerance.source: the parts list: every resistor 1 %, every capacitor X5R or X7R at 10 %; CBUS is an estimate, and 10 % is not its tolerance: the README names it as not measured
